Animated Slime by Calciumtrice, usable under Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 license.

An animated slime monster, includes four colour versions. Each colour has the following animations:

  • idle
  • gesture
  • walk
  • attack
  • death

Recommended for use with my dungeon tileset which can be found HERE.

*Now updated to ten frames per animation at 32x32 to match my other animated characters and monsters.*

Credit should be given to Calciumtrice. I can be found on twitter as @Calciumtrice if you'd like to contact me or see my work at calciumtrice.tumblr.com. I am available for comissions!
